title: Ratify reports the dangling granularity ladder

facts.note: The Ratify invocation on a plan session is directly observable.
Source validation phase is CONFIRM; a phase observer must map plan-session ratification to CONFIRM.
Fires when the decomposition did not descend some rungs of the ladder (wagon, feature, WMBT, acceptance). Computed by the Ratify validator for the plan session.
Whether the planner is ratifying a decomposition is judged from the task wording.

fires: A plan session is ratified while it keeps wagons and nothing else.
A plan session is ratified whose decomposition did not descend one or more rungs of the ladder down to acceptance.
`atdd plan ratify --strict` is run on a decomposition with rungs not descended (refusal, session left unlocked).
doesNotFire: A plan session is ratified whose decomposition descended every rung of the ladder: wagon, feature, WMBT, acceptance.
The planner edits a plan session without ratifying it.
Coder or tester work on code and tests outside a plan session.

given: A plan session whose decomposition did not descend every rung of the granularity ladder (wagon → feature → WMBT → acceptance)
then: Ratify names the rungs of the ladder the decomposition did not descend, so the operator is told the locked plan is not testable end to end instead of having to notice it.
prefer: Compose incrementally: ratify the slice in scope (planner.decomposition.local-scope) and let the report name the rungs not yet descended.
Opt into `atdd plan ratify --strict` when the repo wants a hard gate; it unlocks before raising, so the refusal is atomic.
avoid: Treating a wagons-only plan as done: it names a shape but nothing testable.
Blocking non-strict ratification until features exist (e.g. refusing to lock eight wagons); that makes the session unusable.
why: A wagons-only plan names a shape but nothing testable. Advisory by default, deliberately, to allow incremental composition; the failure closed is detection — only an operator holding the protocol in memory noticed a wagons-only plan had locked.
evidence: When rungs were not descended, the Ratify report carries session_id, kept_kinds and dangling_rungs (the rungs not descended).
With --strict, Ratify raises and the session is left unlocked (atomic refusal).
verifier_detail: Ladder rungs in order: wagon, feature, WMBT, acceptance. Dangling rungs are the rungs of the ladder the decomposition did not descend.
Disposition advisory (enforcement advisory, severity 2) by default, deliberately: report, do not block the lock.
Strict opt-in: `atdd plan ratify --strict` turns the report into a refusal; it unlocks before raising so the refusal is atomic.
Failure evidence fields: session_id, kept_kinds, dangling_rungs.
